AddMosaics.description_en: Adds a mosaic to a custom area

AddRelativePosition.description_en: Submits the relative positions between sub-scenes
AddRelativePosition.description_zh: 提交子场景间相对位置

AddRoomPlan.description_en: Uploads house data generated by mobile-side algorithm processing to the cloud, where the cloud algorithm module performs 3D model reconstruction
AddRoomPlan.description_zh: 通过移动端算法处理会生成相应的房屋数据，将该数据上传至云端后，可通过云端算法模块进行三维模型重建

AddScene.description_en: Creates a main scene of a specific type
AddScene.description_zh: 创建特定类型的主场景

AddSubScene.description_en: Adds a new sub-scene under a specified main scene
AddSubScene.description_zh: 在指定的主场景下添加新的子场景

CheckUserProperty.description_en: Checks whether a user has a specified business property
CheckUserProperty.description_zh: 检查用户是否具有指定业务属性

CopyScene.description_zh: 可以把原来的场景复制一份

DetailProject.description_en: Queries the basic information of a project

DetailScene.description_en: Retrieves information about a specified main scene

DetailSubScene.description_en: Queries the information about a sub-scene

DropProject.description_en: Deletes an existing project. A project that contains published scenarios cannot be deleted
DropProject.description_zh: 删除已有项目，项目下存在已发布场景的不支持删除

GetConnData.description_en: Retrieves association information for use during annotation
GetConnData.description_zh: 获取关联信息，标注时使用

GetCopySceneTaskStatus.description_en: Queries the task status of a replication scenario
GetCopySceneTaskStatus.description_zh: 查询复制场景任务状态

GetHotspotConfig.description_en: Queries the hot spot annotation configuration, which is used during post-processing
GetHotspotConfig.description_zh: 查询热点标注配置,后处理时使用

GetHotspotSceneData.description_en: Queries scene model preview data based on a preview token
GetHotspotSceneData.description_zh: 根据预览token查询场景模型预览数据

GetHotspotTag.description_en: Retrieves hotspot annotation information for use during post-processing
GetHotspotTag.description_zh: 获取热点标注信息，后处理时使用

GetLayoutData.description_en: Retrieves the latest annotation information for use during annotation
GetLayoutData.description_zh: 获取最新标注信息，标注时使用

GetOriginLayoutData.description_en: Retrieves the original annotation information. You can use this operation together with the update annotation information operation to restore annotation information
GetOriginLayoutData.description_zh: 获取原始标注信息，可以配合更新标注信息接口使用来还原标注信息

GetOssPolicy.description_en: Obtains OSS authorization. After obtaining the authorization, use the OSS SDK to upload image or video files to the specified path. After the upload is complete, call the LinkImage operation to add images to a sub-scene
GetOssPolicy.description_zh: 获取oss授权，获取授权后使用OSS SDK往指定路径上传图片或视频文件，上传完后直接调用LinkImage接口往子场景中添加图片

GetPackSceneTaskStatus.description_en: Retrieves the packaging status of scene data
GetPackSceneTaskStatus.description_zh: 获取场景数据打包状态

GetRectifyImage.description_en: Retrieves the image after vertical correction
GetRectifyImage.description_zh: 获取垂直矫正后的图片

GetSceneBuildTaskStatus.description_en: Queries the status of a 3D Space Reconstruction task
GetSceneBuildTaskStatus.description_zh: 查询场景重建任务状态

GetScenePackUrl.description_en: Retrieves the data package URL after calling the PackScene operation, so that you can download the package
GetScenePackUrl.description_zh: 用于调用PackScene接口后，获取数据包地址，以便于下载

GetScenePreviewData.description_en: Retrieves scene preview data for model rendering
GetScenePreviewData.description_zh: 场景预览数据，用于模型渲染

GetScenePreviewInfo.description_en: Retrieves point information of a scene model
GetScenePreviewInfo.description_zh: 获取场景模型点位信息

GetScenePreviewResource.description_zh: 用于模型类场景的预览

GetSingleConnData.description_en: Retrieves the association information of a single image

GetSourcePackStatus.description_en: Retrieves the packaging status of a panorama file
GetSourcePackStatus.description_zh: 获取全景图文件打包状态

GetSubSceneTaskStatus.description_en: Queries the pre-processing and image segmentation status of a sub-scene
GetSubSceneTaskStatus.description_zh: 子场景的预处理及切图状态

GetTaskStatus.description_en: Queries the status of a task. You can query the status of all types of tasks
GetTaskStatus.description_zh: 查询任务状态，可以查询所有类型任务状态

GetWindowConfig.description_en: Retrieves system configuration information, used for preview and post-processing
GetWindowConfig.description_zh: 获取系统配置信息，预览、后处理时使用

LinkImage.description_en: Associates an image or video with a sub-scene. Currently, only one image or one video can be associated with a sub-scene
LinkImage.description_zh: 关联图片或视频到子场景，目前一个子场景只能关联一张图片或者一个视频

ListProject.description_en: Retrieves a paginated list of all projects
ListProject.description_zh: 分页获取所有项目列表

ListScene.description_en: Retrieves all main scene lists under a specified project
ListScene.description_zh: 获取指定项目下的所有主场景列表

ListSubScene.description_en: Queries a paginated list of sub-scenes

OptimizeRightAngle.description_en: Optimizes wall intersections to right angles
OptimizeRightAngle.description_zh: 将墙交汇处优化为直角

PackScene.description_en: Packages scene data. If the type parameter is set to download, the data can be downloaded to a local machine. If the type parameter is set to sync, the data can be synchronized to your own Alibaba Cloud OSS bucket (provided that OSS has been activated)
PackScene.description_zh: 打包场景数据，入参type为download可下载到本地，入参type为sync可可同步到自己的阿里云oss（前提是自己已开通）

PackSource.description_en: Retrieves all panoramic images under the 3D model type
PackSource.description_zh: 获取3D模型类型下所有全景图片

PredImage.description_en: Pre-processes images, including vertical correction, wall line prediction, and door prediction. You can call this operation to retry when automatic door prediction or image cropping fails
PredImage.description_zh: 图片预处理，包括垂直矫正、墙线预测、门预测，自动门预测与切图失败时可使用此接口发起重试

PredictionWallLine.description_en: Predicts wall lines and returns a task ID and a subscene ID. You can query the task status by task ID. After the task is completed, you can query the specific wall line data by subscene ID
PredictionWallLine.description_zh: 墙线预测，返回taskId以及subsceneId，可以根据taskId查询任务状态，任务结束后可以根据subsceneId查询具体墙线数据

RecoveryOriginImage.description_en: Resets and recovers a mosaic image to its original state
RecoveryOriginImage.description_zh: 该接口用于打马赛克图片的重置恢复

RectVertical.description_en: Performs vertical correction on images in a specified sub-scene. After the correction, the association with the sub-scene is deleted
RectVertical.description_zh: 对指定子场景下的图片进行垂直矫正，矫正后会删除该子场景关联关系

RectifyImage.description_en: Performs vertical correction on an input image
RectifyImage.description_zh: 对输入图片进行垂直矫正

RollbackSubScene.description_en: Restores a deleted sub-scene in a panoramic shot scenario
RollbackSubScene.description_zh: 用于全景类型场景中已删除的子场景的恢复

SaveHotspotConfig.description_en: Saves the hotspot annotation configuration for use during post-processing
SaveHotspotConfig.description_zh: 保存热点标注配置，后处理时使用

SaveHotspotTag.description_en: Saves hotspot annotation information for use during post-processing
SaveHotspotTag.description_zh: 保存热点标注信息，后处理时使用

TempPreview.description_en: Retrieves a preview link after reconstruction is complete
TempPreview.description_zh: 重建后可以调用此预览接口获取预览链接

TempPreviewStatus.description_en: Queries the status of a preview task. After you call TempPreview, you can use this operation to check the task status. The preview link is available only after the task is completed. Call this operation within 10 minutes after calling TempPreview
TempPreviewStatus.description_zh: 查询预览任务状态，调用TempPreview后可以使用此接口查看任务状态，当任务结束后才可以使用预览链接进行预览，需要在调用TempPreview接口后10分钟之内调用

UpdateConnData.description_en: Updates association information, used during annotation to save the latest association data
UpdateConnData.description_zh: 更新关联信息，标注时使用，保存最新关联数据

UpdateLayoutData.description_en: Updates annotation information. After annotation, you can use this operation to save the annotation information
UpdateLayoutData.description_zh: 更新标注信息，标注后可以使用此接口保存标注信息

UpdateProject.description_en: Updates the information of a specified project

UpdateScene.description_en: Updates the name of a scenario

UpdateSubScene.description_en: Updates the information of a specified sub-scene
UpdateSubScene.description_zh: 更新指定的子场景信息

UpdateSubSceneSeq.description_en: Previews the order of sub-scenes on a page
UpdateSubSceneSeq.description_zh: 此接口用于预览页面中子场景的顺序
